text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер turns heads in her debut
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And yet, the media only see her as the
next
Марузенски.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As if to fan the flames, Грасс Вандер
declares
her intentions to run in the
Asahi Hai F.S., where
Марузенски set an
all-time record.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
